questions.prompt: You start pi with --system-prompt packs/sql/prompt.md. Which sections of the prompt does pi still add?
options: Tools, rules and docs, plus your text
The addendum, project instructions, skills and working folder
Nothing, because the flag turns off all sections
questions.explanation: A custom prompt replaces the preamble and drops tools, rules and docs. The addendum, project_context, skills and cwd are still added.

options: When the expert must not act like a coding assistant
When the expert is close to a coding assistant and keeps its habits
When you want to remove the tool list
When you have no prompt file
questions.explanation: Append keeps pi's preamble, tools, rules and docs and adds your addendum, so it suits an expert that is close to a coding assistant.

questions.prompt: You pass --system-prompt packs/sql/prompt.md and the file exists. What does pi do with the value?
options: It uses the path as the prompt text
It reads the file and uses its content
It adds the file to the addendum
questions.explanation: A flag value that is a path to an existing file is read as that file.
